contexts.title: Prism API retry guide
contexts.text:
# API reliability at Prism

The API permits 1200 requests per minute per workspace. Requests above the quota receive HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header in seconds. Honor Retry-After before retrying. If it is missing, use exponential backoff with full jitter: initial delays 1, 2, 4, and 8 seconds, capped at 30 seconds. Stop after five attempts. Never retry a write without an idempotency key.
